requirements.quote:
An endpoint MUST discard its Handshake keys when the TLS handshake is
   confirmed (Section 4.1.2).
requirements.condition: When the TLS handshake is confirmed
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint discards its Handshake keys.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retain or continue using Handshake keys after handshake confirmation.
requirements.why_checkable: A handshake-state test can observe key storage and attempt Handshake-level processing immediately after confirmation to verify that the keys were discarded.
